lines.en: : ...And so I say to the guy, “You can’t kick me out! My father owns the place!”
: And so he’s all like, “Miss, that doesn’t mean you’re allowed to just free all of the animals! That will put them in danger!”
: So I grab him by the collar of his stupid shirt and I look him in the eyes and say...
: My middle name is danger...and if you’ve got a problem with me freeing a few puppies, I’ve got the nerve to show you why.
: But...that’s not your middle name. You don’t even have a middle name. You’re Japanese.
: Hold the phone. Why would anyone get into trouble over freein’ some puppies? Puppies are supposed to be free!
: I don’t think there’s anywhere in the world, let alone Japan, where puppies are supposed to roam free.
: The vast majority of dogs, other than wild ones like wolves I mean, are domesticated.
: So the chances of a normal puppy surviving alone in the wilderness is significantly lower than it would be should that puppy be in the care of a human.
: ...Why do ya gotta be so real all the time?
: Why can’t ya just let my innocent heart think about some happy puppies floodin’ the streets of Kumon-mi?
: Because that would cause a multitude of problems that-
: So anyway, how was your night, Karin? You went out jogging, didn’t you?
: I think most of us were probably asleep by the time you got back, right?
: Oh, uhh, yeah. It was nice. I kind of forgot how much harder it is to run in the sand, so that was a little bit of a wake up call.
: You were able to find a spot in the room, though, right? I know it was kinda cramped in there. Especially with Molly sprawling out all over the place.
: Yeah...I felt really bad for the one girl...Rin, I think?
: She was basically hugging her the entire night.
: Rin?! Imagine how I feel! I barely even know the girl and she was all up on me like I was her friggin’ body pillow!
: I felt like I was two steps away from gettin’ married with how close we were!
: You should have come slept next to me like I told you to in the first place.
: What, you mean right in front of the bathroom? Wouldn’t it be annoying havin’ people step over you to get in all night?
: I don’t even think I woke up at all. But I’m kind of a heavy sleeper so...yeah.
: I’m really thankful for that, by the way. Because I totally kicked you when I went in there to get dressed last night and you didn’t even move.
: Gee. Thank you, beloved sister, for abusing me in my sleep. I’ll be sure to return the favor tonight.
: I’ll be sure to not go to sleep until really late then.
: Oh, I've been meaning to ask...What’s it like having a little sister, Karin?
: I’ve always wanted one myself but my parents have always been pretty adamant about only having one child.
: Yeah, Karin. What’s it like? Answer very carefully.
: Well...
: That’s kind of a hard question.
: Very carefully...
: Kirin and I don’t always get along. In fact, she was pretty unbearable when the two of us were little.
: Being taller and older than her meant that she got a lot of my old clothes as I grew out of them, but that never stopped her from taking the ones I still used either...
: Plus, I can’t even remember how many fights we’ve gotten into over other stupid stuff like where to go out to eat or what to name our cat.
: I won the cat battle, in case anyone is wondering.
: I’m clearly the superior sister.
: Is that really what you think? That you won?
: Uhh...well we went with the name I chose, so yeah. That counts as a victory for me.
: We went with a name that you agreed to. And you chose it out of a hat.
: Whatever, still my name. You weren’t allowed to put anything in the hat anyway.
: That’s just what Mom told you.
: The real truth is that I made up all of the names in the hat and just let you pick whichever one because I liked them all.
: You bitch!
: You two have been lying to me for years and letting me think I named the cat, when it’s really just been one long prank?!
: I don’t even want the cat anymore! Take it back to the pet store!
: That pet store closed down like six years ago...
: And besides, you love Pancake. I don’t believe for a split second that you’d give him up that easily.
: Yeah well...fuck you, Karin.
: I love you too!
: Your relationship seems a little more...complicated than I imagined it would be based on how often you two are together.
: I always figured having a little sister would be like always having someone to look after and...train, I guess.
: Kind of like a mini-version of myself.
: Oh, heck no! I can barely deal with one of you!
: Ya have any idea how hard my life would be with two Makoto’s? I’d never have time for soccer anymore.
: True, but at least you’d be passing math.
: What even is math?!
: It’s the subject with all of the numbers.
: I know what it is! But like, what the heck is it?! You know?!
: No.
: Well, at the end of the day, I think it’s pretty safe to say that Kirin isn’t anything like me.
: You’ve got that right...
: But honestly, I can’t imagine what life would be like without her.
: Even if we fight all of the time and even if she stole like half of my clothes when we were growing up, thinking about doing all of that without her just seems pointless.
: It sounds dumb, I’m sure, but I love her a lot. She means the world to me and, as her big sister, I’ll always have her back no matter what.
: Sis, what the fuck?! Why are you getting all sappy all of a sudden?!
: I haven’t even had breakfast yet! I don’t want to hear that!
: Don’t want to hear what? That I love you?
: Yes! You can’t just...say stuff like that in public! It’s embarrassing!
: I love you, Kirin!
: Ahhhhhhh!
: Hey, Tsuneyo. Whatcha thinkin’ about over there?
: You’ve been pretty quiet all morning and I just want to make sure you’re not feeling left out or anything.
: Yeah. We’re all friends here. Tell us what’s on your mind.
: Masturbation.
: Did I say something wrong?
: Well...no!
: I mean, I’m sure we all...everyone once in a while, but...
: Breakfast isn’t really the...best time to bring something like that up.
: It’s not?
: No...it’s just like...
: You know what? Maybe you should just go back to the inn alone for a little while if you really need to...do that.
: Do what?
: Masturbate, obviously.
: But I don’t know how.
: What?...
: I don’t know what masturbation is.
: I heard our teacher use the word yesterday and he told me it would be best to ask all of you about it.
: Pfft...
: That son of a bitch.
: Would you...maybe mind explaining why Sensei would have told you to ask us about something like that?
: He said that it was something that he probably shouldn’t teach me about and that one of you would show me.
: That son of a bitch...
: HAHAHAH! OH MY GOD!
: Well, uhh...I guess the easiest way to explain it would be that it’s like...sex that you do to yourself.
: With like, your fingers or...toys or...the corner of the boy you admire’s desk.
: Pretty much anything can get the job done if you try hard enough.
: Is...anyone else getting dizzy?
: I see.
: So it is sex that you do to yourself.
: Exactly.
: Okay.
: Great, so I guess we can just-
: What is sex?
: HAHAHAHAHAHAHAH!!!! AHHHHHH!!!!
: Ahh! Karin died! Someone call an ambulance!
: She’s not dead, Miku. She just...needs a minute to recover, I think.
: Is the tall girl with the beautiful abs going to be okay?
: Yeah...She’ll be fine.
: You’re the one I’m worried about.
: I don’t understand.
: I know you don’t...
: How about the two of us have a conversation in private later, okay?
: Are you going to teach me how to sex?
: Let’s just...
: Sure. Yeah. I’ll teach you how to sex.
: So, what are you planning on doing today, Ami?
: Me? I don’t know. More vacation stuff probably.
: I know Ayane and some of the other girls are eating breakfast right now, but I can’t imagine they’re talking about anything exciting.
: Well let’s hope you didn’t miss anything fun.
Ami and I make it to the beach a short while later to find Karin passed out on her plate of breakfast.
I guess she must have had a long night.
I decide to get some food from a nearby stall and scarf down an omelette before setting off to find something else to do this morning.
